style: Stylized heroic fantasy painting in the look of a hand-painted 2D animated fantasy cinematic short: bold simplified shapes, slightly heroic sturdy proportions (broad shoulders, solid armour and props), heavy confident painterly brush strokes, hand-painted textures, rich saturated colour with a limited palette per scene, strong warm rim light against deep cool shadows, big areas of calm empty darkness, atmospheric haze between clear foreground, middle ground and background layers, cinematic widescreen composition. No ink outlines and no comic line art: edges are defined only by paint and light. Grounded anatomy and believable faces with real weight and emotion, semi-realistic like a painted cinematic short, not a cartoon, not a comic, not photorealistic, not a book illustration. Full-bleed image edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no frame, no watermark.

cast.lucien: Lucien Vale, a young half-elf wild magic sorcerer who loves to sing and play music, a good-hearted man who was betrayed: long straight blond hair, pointed elf ears, clean-shaven handsome face with fine elven features and a straight, slim, normal-sized nose, lively expressive eyes, burgundy velvet long coat with brass buttons over a dark shirt, leather belt with a dagger whose blade glows faintly blue, faint purple arcane sparks flickering at his fingertips, a lute on his back, slim build. His face is full of life and follows the scene: shouting, laughing, fierce, cocky, scheming, grieving only when the scene grieves. Sympathetic hero, never sinister or villainous
cast.arthas: Arthas, a tall devout human paladin: full dark steel plate armour, a dark cloth hood always worn up over a closed steel helm (hood visible in every view), two burning orange eye slits, broad shoulders, heavy bronze-hilted longsword, a faded holy sun emblem on his chest
cast.cedric: Cedric 'Cold-Eye', a human monk: shaved head, short dark beard, hard pale grey eyes, red and brown leather monk wraps over a green tunic, one bronze dragon-shaped shoulder pauldron, prayer beads, a long wooden staff, wiry strong build
cast.severin: Severin, a tall pale woman of the forest: very long straight silver-white hair, dark moss-green hooded ranger cloak, faint mint-green glowing eyes, calm unreadable face, a soft green light around her
cast.cube: a gelatinous cube: a huge transparent, faintly green block of jelly in the exact shape of a perfect cube with flat sides and straight edges, taller than a man, almost invisible, bones and coins floating inside it, never shaped like a person or creature
cast.moonwell: the first moonwell site, laid out as in the reference photo of the tabletop model
cast.pig: the Pig, a hulking humanoid butcher about three metres tall with the head of a pig: heavy jowls, short tusks, small cruel eyes, reddish-pink skin, a leather butcher's apron soaked in blood, thick arms, a huge broadaxe, covered head to toe in blood
cast.baphomet: Baphomet, a goat-headed demon imprisoned deep beneath a moonlit lake, only ever seen as an enormous face beneath its black water, never rising out of it: long curved black horns, matted dark fur, cracked skin glowing like embers, burning yellow eyes
cast.neris: Neris, a wiry forest druid in his forties who carries a wolf curse: moss-green hooded ranger cloak over worn leather, a gnarled wooden staff, gaunt weathered face, unkempt dark hair and short beard, amber eyes, a haunted desperate look
cast.kalen: Kalen, a Church paladin the brothers know: a broad young man in his twenties, short brown hair, a square jaw, dented white-and-steel Church plate with a gold sun emblem, torn white tabard, bloodied and bruised, wrists chained
cast.wolves: werewolves: hulking grey and brown wolf-men with snouts, fangs, glowing yellow eyes, ragged fur and torn clothes, carrying burning torches
